description: M10.7 claim-level evidence set. SYNTHETIC and SMALL: written by hand (by the coding assistant, 2026-11-04) over invented policy passages; not drawn from real users, real documents or real model answers, and far below the size the proposed support-label gate requires. Labels: supported (the passage states the claim), unsupported (the passage does not state it), conflicting (the passage states something incompatible). It includes cases chosen to defeat word overlap (changed numbers, flipped negation, swapped roles, paraphrase). Use it to measure a checker, never as evidence that answers are correct.

passages.travel: Employees may book economy fares for flights under six hours. Business class is allowed for flights of six hours or longer. Hotel stays are reimbursed up to 180 euros per night. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the trip.
passages.leave: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave. Unused leave may be carried over, up to a maximum of 5 days. Leave requests must be approved by the line manager. Sick leave does not reduce the annual leave balance.
passages.security: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all remote access. Laptops are encrypted with full-disk encryption. Personal USB drives are not permitted on company devices.
passages.expenses: The finance team reimburses approved expenses within 10 working days. Meals with clients are reimbursed up to 60 euros per person. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Mileage is paid at 0.30 euros per kilometre.
passages.remote: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Remote work from another country requires approval from HR. The company provides a monitor and a keyboard for home offices. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00.
passages.retention: Customer records are retained for seven years after the contract ends. Support tickets are deleted after two years. Backups are kept for 35 days. Deletion requests are processed within one month.
